_note: Standalone single-mode manifest config. sk-git is a normal skill (no mode-registry.json); its references/assets/feature-catalog/playbook docs are all routable leaves, but only two of those roots are reached by the intent router. ROUTER.md discovers resources from its own RESOURCE_BASES, which covers references/ and assets/, and its INTENT_SIGNALS + RESOURCE_MAP loads only those; the feature-catalog/ and manual-testing-playbook/ leaves are reached through the generated leaf manifest instead. scripts/ (the worktree naming allocator and hooks) and benchmark/ are not routable leaves and are excluded because they sit outside leafRoots. Consumed by generate-leaf-manifest.cjs to emit leaf-manifest.json; leaf-aliases.json is the derived identity projection of that manifest, so regenerate both together via ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --fix.
